correctness.rationale: Every polygon is the hull of some subset of the sixteen integer grid sites; monotone-chain integer determinant hull extraction deduplicates all subsets. The convex normal fan partitions objective directions by primitive edge-normal rays and open sectors, whose directed adjacency is constant. Exact integer shortest increasing-path DP on each direction is exhaustive. Independent enumeration found 2719 unique hulls, all seven (vertex-count, diameter) strata 516,1038,648,200,292,24,1; unique H eight vertices and diameter 4; checked all nongeneric rays. This is a genuine *finite exhaustive proof*, not an extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Black 2026 gives high-dimensional exponential examples for [0,3] grid boxes and Black 2022 treats [0,2] grid bounds, while Chadder–Deza address undirected graph diameter. None of these implies the 2719-polygon exact planar three-grid table. A prior exhaustive table or online database is a residual risk.
